prompts.subject: Raised dune-grass edging: large sharp sculptural teal and sea-green blade clusters sticking upward and outward from a low continuous pale sand/cream packed-dune root strip with small angular slate pebbles. Grass is a sequence of broad zigzag/wedge leaves, not painted flat onto tiles and not countless thin hairs. Use warm ochre sand side-face plus vivid restrained turquoise, 2tones each. H is a long raised grass ribbon; V is a top-down vertical raised ribbon with the exact same materials; C is a compact matching grass tuft on an angular sand-and-slate junction. NO wooden box or planter frame, NO round grass puffs.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent native component-kit illustration for an orthogonal top-down 2D coastal puzzle game's connected decorative strip. This is production sprite artwork, no labels or diagrams.
Canvas composition: a wide landscape transparent sheet, ideally1536x1024. Exactly THREE separate matching pieces of ONE family, no other props. A: long horizontal continuous carrier in upper-left region x40..1290,y70..340, about five times wider than tall; clean cut ends, no terminal posts, no end caps. B: long north-south continuous carrier in far-right column x1370..1510,y50..980, clean cut ends and no terminal caps; genuine square-grid top-down direction, not an isometric diagonal. C: one compact decorative junction/corner-cap cluster at lower-left x170..480,y560..930. Leave huge transparent gaps between A,B,C. Keep each piece entirely inside its assigned region. There must be no decorative frame enclosing the sheet.
Art style: very thick crisp near-black NAVY outer contour, thin simple internal lines, hard angular silhouette with long straight segments, wedges and trapezoids. Flat solid-color masses, strictly2–3 hard-edged cel tones per material. No gradients, grain, watercolor, brush texture, realistic3D, shine, soft shading, airbrush, blur, rounded bulbous forms or pixel art. Every small detail follows straight segments and sharp corners. Top-down square ground plane with a short readable front face; no diamond isometric base. Consistent lit upper-left, shadows solid navy-blue planes. True transparent alpha around all three separate pieces. No sky, ground field, ocean field, words, numbers, characters, symbols, watermark, checkerboard or fake transparency.

prompts.subject: Coral-and-slate rock edging: low continuous angular charcoal-blue/slate rock curb with short vivid rust/coral-red branching fan shapes sticking up. Coral branches are thick angular zigzag forks with triangular flat-cut tips, never rounded tubes, circles or beads. Rock silhouettes have few large facets; very crisp navy outlines. H long coral rock ribbon; V genuine top-down north-south ribbon, all same shape language and material scale; C compact branching coral fan/rock junction. Warm coral accent with cream small shell-shaped wedge shards, teal restrained tiny accent. NO round shells, bubbles, craters or soft pebble shading.

prompts.subject: Low harbor foot-light channel: a continuous simple weathered driftwood/cream timber sill with inset small diamond-shaped warm amber glass lanterns and navy iron brackets, NOT tall lampposts. Glass housings are sharply faceted diamonds/trapezoids, thick navy outlines, solid amber base+cream cutout highlight, no glow/bloom. H long footlight sill with a few evenly spaced tiny lanterns; V true top-down north-south matching sill; C compact square-cut timber corner junction supporting one small diamond lantern. Colors driftwood brown, pale sand/cream, slate/navy, warm amber and restrained coral. NO rounded bulbs, circles, rings, cables, posts or machinery. Decorative only, no directional arrows.
